evidence: Touches `src/node/blockstorage.h` and alters `CBlockIndexWorkComparator`, which manages block index ordering and chainstate candidate traversal.
rationale: Inlining and modernizing the block index work comparator yields measurable micro-benchmark improvements, reducing `CheckBlockIndex` operation time by ~1.4x–1.6x. The performance gains are localized to block index traversal routines rather than noticeably transforming full node IBD performance.
